annotation_decisions: Strict hierarchy applied: COURSE > MODULE > UNIT > KC.
Printed family headings 'RESSOURCES EN EAU', 'LES ETABLISSEMENTS', and 'LES TECHNIQUES D’EXTINCTION' are treated as MODULE nodes.
Major fiches listed in the Sommaire are treated as UNIT nodes under their corresponding family MODULE.
Visible numbered/internal subheadings inside a fiche are treated as KC nodes.
Preface and end-matter annex pages are kept as standalone KCs under COURSE because they are not printed under one of the three family headings.
Page grounding follows printed page anchors from the Sommaire and visible internal headings on the corresponding pages.
